# dominion-protocol

> Epoch-based encrypted access control for Nostr. Tiered audiences, key rotation, and revocable access -- all on standard Nostr relays. HKDF-derived content keys per epoch/tier, AES-256-GCM encryption, Shamir secret sharing for key recovery. Zero custom relay software required.

GitHub: https://github.com/forgesworn/dominion

ESM-only. Requires Node.js 20.19+. Two subpath exports: `dominion-protocol` (main), `dominion-protocol/nostr`.

## Install

npm install dominion-protocol

## Subpath Exports

### dominion-protocol (main entry)

Core crypto primitives -- universal, no Nostr knowledge.

Content key derivation:
- deriveContentKey(privkeyHex, epochId, tier) -> Uint8Array -- HKDF-SHA256 derived 32-byte content key
- contentKeyToHex(ck) -> string -- convert content key to hex
- getCurrentEpochId(length?) -> string -- current epoch ID; length is 'weekly' (default, YYYY-Www), 'daily' (YYYY-MM-DD) or 'monthly' (YYYY-MM)
- getEpochIdForDate(date, length?) -> string -- epoch ID for a specific date (UTC); same length values and default

Encryption (AES-256-GCM):
- encrypt(plaintext, ck) -> string -- encrypt text, returns base64(iv || ciphertext || tag)
- decrypt(ciphertext, ck) -> string -- decrypt base64 ciphertext
- encryptBlob(data, ck) -> Uint8Array -- encrypt binary data
- decryptBlob(encrypted, ck) -> Uint8Array -- decrypt binary data

Shamir secret sharing (GF(256)):
- splitSecret(secret, threshold, totalShares) -> ShamirShare[] -- split any secret (re-exported from @forgesworn/shamir-core)
- reconstructSecret(shares, threshold) -> Uint8Array -- reconstruct from at least threshold shares (re-exported from @forgesworn/shamir-core)
- splitCK(ck, threshold, total) -> CKShare[] -- split a 32-byte content key
- reconstructCK(shares) -> Uint8Array -- reconstruct content key from shares
- encodeCKShare(share) -> string -- encode as "index:hexdata"
- decodeCKShare(encoded) -> CKShare -- decode from "index:hexdata"

Vault config management (pure, immutable):
- defaultConfig() -> DominionConfig -- empty config with family + connections tiers
- addToTier(config, tier, pubkey) -> DominionConfig -- add pubkey to tier
- removeFromTier(config, tier, pubkey) -> DominionConfig -- remove pubkey from tier
- addIndividualGrant(config, pubkey, label) -> DominionConfig -- one-off access grant
- removeIndividualGrant(config, pubkey) -> DominionConfig -- remove grant
- revokePubkey(config, pubkey) -> DominionConfig -- revoke from all tiers + grants
- unrevokePubkey(config, pubkey) -> DominionConfig -- remove from revoked list

Constants:
- KIND_VAULT_SHARE -- 30480
- KIND_VAULT_CONFIG -- 30078 (NIP-78 app-specific data)
- DOMINION_VERSION -- "0.1.0" (library constant, not the npm package version)
- CK_SALT -- "dominion-ck-v1"
- PROTOCOL_LABEL -- "dominion"
- DEFAULT_EPOCH_LENGTH -- "weekly"

Types:
- DominionConfig -- { tiers, individualGrants, revokedPubkeys, epochConfig?, blossomUrl? }
- IndividualGrant -- { pubkey, label, grantedAt }
- CKShare -- { index: number, data: Uint8Array }
- TierName -- 'family' | 'connections' | 'close_friends' | 'subscribers' | string
- EpochLength -- 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' (all three are supported by getCurrentEpochId and getEpochIdForDate)
- EpochConfig -- Record<string, EpochLength>, per-tier epoch length stored in DominionConfig.epochConfig (validated by parseVaultConfig, not read by any function)
- CryptoAlgorithm -- 'secp256k1'
- ShamirShare -- { id: number, threshold: number, data: Uint8Array } (from @forgesworn/shamir-core)
- NostrEvent -- { kind, pubkey, created_at, tags, content }
- VaultShareData -- { fromPubkey, epochId, ckHex, tier, algorithm }

### dominion-protocol/nostr

Nostr event builders and parsers. Returns unsigned, unencrypted events -- caller handles NIP-44 encryption and NIP-59 gift wrapping.

Vault shares (kind 30480):
- buildVaultShareEvent(authorPubkey, recipientPubkey, ckHex, epochId, tier) -> NostrEvent
- parseVaultShare(event) -> VaultShareData | null
- buildVaultShareFilter(authorPubkey, epochId?, tier?) -> filter object

Vault config (kind 30078, NIP-78):
- buildVaultConfigEvent(authorPubkey, config) -> NostrEvent
- parseVaultConfig(contentJson) -> DominionConfig | null
- buildVaultConfigFilter(authorPubkey) -> filter object

Event shapes and tags:
- Kind 30480 share: d = "{epochId}:{tier}", p = recipient pubkey, tier = tier name, encrypted = nip44, algo = secp256k1, L = dominion, l = share (namespace dominion). Content is the raw content key as 64-character hex.
- Kind 30078 config: d = "dominion:vault-config", encrypted = nip44, algo = secp256k1, L = dominion, l = config (namespace dominion). Content is the JSON of the DominionConfig.

Filters:
- buildVaultShareFilter(authorPubkey, epochId?, tier?) -> { kinds: [30480], authors: [authorPubkey] }, plus '#d': ["{epochId}:{tier}"] only when both epochId and tier are given (one on its own is ignored). It never sets '#p' or '#tier'.
- buildVaultConfigFilter(authorPubkey) -> { kinds: [30078], authors: [authorPubkey], '#d': ["dominion:vault-config"] }

Parser inputs:
- parseVaultShare(event) takes the unwrapped rumor: the plain kind 30480 event object after NIP-59 unwrap, whose content is the 64-character hex key. It returns null for the raw gift wrap, any other kind, a missing d tag, content that is still NIP-44 ciphertext, a non-hex pubkey, or an algo tag other than secp256k1. epochId comes from the d tag (text before the first colon), tier from the tier tag (else the d tag suffix, else 'unknown'). It checks no signature and does not look at the p tag, so confirm the sender yourself.
- parseVaultConfig(contentJson) takes the decrypted content string, not an event object. Pass event.content after NIP-44 self-decryption.

## Crypto Details

- CK derivation: HKDF-SHA256(ikm=privkey, salt="dominion-ck-v1", info="epoch:{epochId}:tier:{tier}")
- Encryption: AES-256-GCM, 12-byte random IV, output = base64(iv || ciphertext || tag)
- Shamir: GF(256) with irreducible polynomial 0x11b, threshold 2-255 (via @forgesworn/shamir-core)
- Epoch format: ISO 8601 weeks YYYY-Www by default; daily YYYY-MM-DD and monthly YYYY-MM when a length is passed

## Quick Examples

```typescript
import { deriveContentKey, contentKeyToHex, getCurrentEpochId, encrypt, decrypt } from 'dominion-protocol';

// Derive a content key for this week's "family" tier
const ck = deriveContentKey(privateKeyHex, getCurrentEpochId(), 'family');

// Encrypt content
const ciphertext = encrypt('Hello vault!', ck);
const plaintext = decrypt(ciphertext, ck); // "Hello vault!"
```

```typescript
import { splitCK, reconstructCK, encodeCKShare, decodeCKShare } from 'dominion-protocol';

// Shamir split for key recovery (2-of-3)
const shares = splitCK(ck, 2, 3);
const encoded = shares.map(encodeCKShare); // ["1:ab12...", "2:cd34...", "3:ef56..."]
const recovered = reconstructCK(encoded.slice(0, 2).map(decodeCKShare));
```

```typescript
import { buildVaultShareEvent } from 'dominion-protocol/nostr';

// Build event -- caller must NIP-44 encrypt + NIP-59 gift wrap before publishing
const event = buildVaultShareEvent(authorPubkey, recipientPubkey, ckHex, epochId, 'family');
```

## Dependencies

- @noble/hashes -- HKDF-SHA256, SHA-256, hex utilities
- @noble/ciphers -- AES-256-GCM (synchronous, pure JS)
- @forgesworn/shamir-core -- GF(256) Shamir secret sharing (splitSecret, reconstructSecret, re-exported from the main entry)

## Semantics

Tiers:
- DominionConfig.tiers maps a tier name to either an array of 64-character lowercase hex pubkeys or the literal string 'auto'. 'auto' is only a marker: the library never resolves it, so the client must (for example from a follow list).
- defaultConfig() returns { tiers: { family: [], connections: 'auto' }, individualGrants: [], revokedPubkeys: [] }. There is no close_friends or subscribers key until you add one.
- addToTier(config, tier, pubkey) creates the tier if it does not exist, so addToTier(config, 'close_friends', pk) works on a default config. If the tier is 'auto' it is replaced by an explicit list [pubkey], permanently ending auto-population. Adding an existing member returns the same config object. Tier names '__proto__', 'constructor' and 'prototype' throw "Reserved tier name". The pubkey is not validated here; parseVaultConfig and the event builders validate it.
- removeFromTier returns the config unchanged if the tier is missing or 'auto'. revokePubkey removes the pubkey from every explicit tier list and from individualGrants, and adds it to revokedPubkeys once. addIndividualGrant sets grantedAt to the current Unix time in seconds, and on an existing pubkey only updates the label.
- epochConfig (tier name -> EpochLength) is stored and validated by parseVaultConfig only. No function reads it: pass the tier's length to getCurrentEpochId or getEpochIdForDate yourself.

Epoch IDs and key derivation:
- getCurrentEpochId(length = 'weekly') and getEpochIdForDate(date, length = 'weekly') use UTC. weekly -> YYYY-Www (ISO 8601 week), daily -> YYYY-MM-DD, monthly -> YYYY-MM. A different length gives a different epoch ID and therefore a different key.
- deriveContentKey requires a 64-character lowercase hex private key (uppercase is rejected), a non-empty epochId that does not contain ":tier:", and a non-empty tier that does not contain ":".

Encryption and errors:
- decrypt and decryptBlob throw on a wrong key or tampered data (AES-GCM authentication failure, currently "aes-gcm: invalid tag" from @noble/ciphers). They never return null or garbage. decrypt also throws a DOMException from atob on malformed base64, and both throw "Ciphertext too short" for fewer than 28 bytes of input.
- encryptBlob output is the 12-byte random IV, then the ciphertext, then the 16-byte GCM tag. Length is input length + 28, with no magic bytes or version field. encrypt is base64 of the same layout over the UTF-8 plaintext.
- Builders and filter builders (buildVaultShareEvent, buildVaultConfigEvent, buildVaultShareFilter, buildVaultConfigFilter) throw on invalid input. Parsers (parseVaultShare, parseVaultConfig) return null instead of throwing.
- parseVaultConfig returns null unless tiers, individualGrants and revokedPubkeys have the expected shapes, every pubkey is 64-character lowercase hex, epochConfig values are 'daily', 'weekly' or 'monthly', and blossomUrl (if present) starts with http:// or https://.

Constants and algorithm:
- VaultShareData.algorithm is always 'secp256k1' (the CryptoAlgorithm type). buildVaultShareEvent sets the tag ['algo', 'secp256k1']. parseVaultShare treats a missing algo tag as 'secp256k1' and returns null for any other value.
- DOMINION_VERSION is the string '0.1.0'. It is a constant in the library and is not the npm package version.
